messages:
Rowan: Postmortem follow-up: GPU surge last night. Short list of remediation items and owners so we can close the loop. Root cause: bursty batch jobs + autoscaler cooldowns + tight quotas.
Mei: Please post owners + hard ETA. I can take runbook.
Rowan: Actions:
1) Scheduler policy tweak (lower preemption threshold, adjust binpack) — Owner: Carlos — ETA 48h
2) Autoscaler changes (scaleDown grace->20s, minHeadroom 12%) — Owner: Tian — ETA 24h
3) Provisional quota request (+20% for 48h) — Owner: Mei — ETA submit today (TICKET CAP-5123)
4) Runbook addendum: paste-ready commands + escalation matrix — Owner: Mei — ETA PR by EOD
Carlos: I'll validate scheduler tweak in staging and run a mixed workload. Will post perf numbers.
Tian: I'll apply autoscaler patch as canary and monitor pod churn. Snippet I'll add to runbook:
```
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"scaleDownGrace":"20s","minHeadroom":"0.12"}}'
```
Mei: CAP-5123 opened and linked to INC-4012. Marked provisional 48h window. PR created WIP: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/199 (DO NOT MERGE until quota confirmed).
Rowan: Ops-bot: schedule quick sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to review staging results. Weekly check-ins for 3 weeks after closure.
ops-bot: Calendar: GPU-capacity-check 2025-11-05 09:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.
Carlos: Early staging shows tail latency improvement. Uploading graphs.
Mei: I'll update runbook with exact escalation steps and add a acceptance gate: <50% surge incidents over 2 weeks or quota approved.
Rowan: Thanks all — I'll update the incident tracker and close once validation criteria met. Ping here for handoffs.
